# Setup

## Open and build

Open `Package.swift` in Xcode. Shared schemes: Xcode's auto-generated scheme. Validate with `CardGameKit`.
There is no test plan; the scheme test action runs the unit tests.

```sh
xcodebuild -scheme CardGameKit -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' build
swift test        # when the package has no iOS-only APIs in its tests
```

When several agent sessions are open on this project, only one builds or
tests at a time (CORE-VER-003).

## Local configuration

No git-ignored configuration files are required.

## Lint

`.swiftlint.yml` inherits the handbook base (IOS-QUAL-001).

```sh
swiftlint lint --no-cache                  # whole project
swiftlint lint --no-cache path/to/File.swift   # files you changed
```
